description: Source code for WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool class managing WebSocket socket pooling, connection requests, and related operations within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of WebSocket transport client sockets, handles connection requests, stalls, and socket lifecycle.

classes.name: ConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: Delegates connection job completion handling and proxy authentication callbacks.

classes.name: StalledRequest
classes.description: Represents a stalled socket request waiting for resources.

methods.name: RequestSocket
methods.description: Handles a request for a WebSocket socket, either initiating a new connection or stalling if limits are reached.

methods.name: RequestSockets
methods.description: Bulk request for multiple sockets (not implemented).

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of a socket request (not implemented).

methods.name: CancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels a pending or stalled socket request.

methods.name: ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool.

methods.name: FlushWithError
methods.description: Fails all pending and stalled requests with an error.

methods.name: CloseIdleSockets
methods.description: Closes all idle sockets (no idle sockets in this implementation).

methods.name: CloseIdleSocketsInGroup
methods.description: Closes idle sockets in a specific group (none in this implementation).

methods.name: IdleSocketCount
methods.description: Returns count of idle sockets (always zero).

methods.name: IdleSocketCountInGroup
methods.description: Returns count of idle sockets in a group (always zero).

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state for a request.

methods.name: GetInfoAsValue
methods.description: Returns pool info as a JSON value.

methods.name: HasActiveSocket
methods.description: Checks if a group has an active socket (not supported).

methods.name: IsStalled
methods.description: Checks if there are stalled requests.

methods.name: AddHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Adds a higher layered pool (not used).

methods.name: RemoveHigherLayeredPool
methods.description: Removes a higher layered pool (not used).

methods.name: TryHandOutSocket
methods.description: Attempts to hand out a socket after connection.

methods.name: HandOutSocket
methods.description: Assigns a socket to a handle and updates counters.

methods.name: AddJob
methods.description: Adds a new connection job delegate to pending connections.

methods.name: DeleteJob
methods.description: Removes a connection job delegate from pending connections.

methods.name: LookupConnectJob
methods.description: Finds a connection job delegate for a handle.

methods.name: ActivateStalledRequest
methods.description: Activates stalled requests if possible.

methods.name: DeleteStalledRequest
methods.description: Removes a stalled request.
